Title: Dead Man Talking
Writer: Donald P. Bellisario, Don McGill, George Schenck
Actors: Mark Harmon, Sasha Alexander, Michael Weatherly
Plot: A guard finds the disemboweled body of an NCIS agent in an elevator; the gang investigate. Gibbs feels responsibility. The victim has pursued a cold case involving a theft of $12M+ from the Navy. NCIS finds the thief and the killer.
